about: ii-windows (plan 2026-10-31, E9): other customization apps ii knows. ii-shim compat <this file> says which are on this PC (a running process, an installed file with %VARIABLES%, or a registry key of HKCU/HKLM, read only); Configuración > Avanzado > Compatibilidad shows their text and fix, and the problem report lists them. Add an app here when a report shows a new one.

apps.name: StartAllBack
apps.es: Cambia la barra de tareas y el Inicio de Windows. ii oculta la barra igual; si ves dos barras, o el Inicio de StartAllBack al pulsar la tecla Windows, desactiva en StartAllBack su barra y su menú Inicio.
apps.en: It changes Windows' taskbar and Start. ii hides the taskbar anyway; if you see two bars, or StartAllBack's Start when you press the Windows key, turn off its taskbar and Start menu in StartAllBack.

apps.name: ExplorerPatcher
apps.es: Cambia la barra de tareas de Explorer, que ii oculta. Si la barra de Windows vuelve a aparecer encima de ii, en ExplorerPatcher elige la barra de Windows 11.
apps.en: It changes Explorer's taskbar, which ii hides. If Windows' taskbar shows again over ii, choose the Windows 11 taskbar in ExplorerPatcher.

apps.name: Windhawk
apps.es: Los mods que cambian la barra de tareas, el menú Inicio o Alt+Tab pueden chocar con ii (una barra que reaparece, teclas que no llegan). Si ves algo raro, desactiva esos mods.
apps.en: Mods that change the taskbar, Start or Alt+Tab can clash with ii (a bar that comes back, keys that do not arrive). If something looks odd, turn those mods off.

apps.name: TranslucentTB
apps.es: Da transparencia a la barra de Windows, que ii oculta: mientras uses ii no hace falta.
apps.en: It makes Windows' taskbar transparent, which ii hides: it is not needed while you use ii.

apps.name: RoundedTB
apps.es: Redondea la barra de Windows, que ii oculta: mientras uses ii no hace falta.
apps.en: It rounds Windows' taskbar, which ii hides: it is not needed while you use ii.

apps.name: Rainmeter
apps.es: Convive con ii. Sus skins pueden quedar detrás del escritorio de ii: ponlos "Siempre encima" o "Normal" en Rainmeter si no los ves.
apps.en: It works with ii. Its skins may end up behind ii's desktop: set them to "Always on top" or "Normal" in Rainmeter if you cannot see them.

apps.name: Wallpaper Engine
apps.es: Dibuja su fondo detrás de los escritorios; ii pone el suyo encima. Para usar los fondos animados de Wallpaper Engine con ii, mira Configuración > Apariencia > Fondos animados.
apps.en: It draws its wallpaper behind the desktops; ii puts its own on top. To use Wallpaper Engine's animated wallpapers with ii, see Configuración > Appearance > Live wallpapers.

apps.name: Lively Wallpaper
apps.es: Dibuja su fondo detrás de los escritorios; ii pone el suyo encima. Mira Configuración > Apariencia > Fondos animados.
apps.en: It draws its wallpaper behind the desktops; ii puts its own on top. See Configuración > Appearance > Live wallpapers.

apps.name: PowerToys
apps.es: Su Selector de color usa Win+Mayús+C, igual que el de ii; PowerToys Run usa Alt+Espacio (sin conflicto con ii). Elige cuál quieres: cambia el atajo de ii en Atajos o el de PowerToys en su configuración.
apps.en: Its Color Picker uses Win+Shift+C, like ii's; PowerToys Run uses Alt+Space (no clash with ii). Pick one: change ii's shortcut in Shortcuts, or PowerToys' in its settings.

apps.name: Flow Launcher
apps.es: Usa Alt+Espacio; ii busca con la tecla Windows: conviven.
apps.en: It uses Alt+Space; ii searches with the Windows key: they work together.

apps.name: AutoHotkey
apps.es: Si un atajo de ii deja de responder, revisa si uno de tus scripts usa la misma combinación (el que se instaló al último recibe la tecla primero).
apps.en: If an ii shortcut stops responding, check whether one of your scripts uses the same combination (the hook installed last gets the key first).

apps.name: Nilesoft Shell
apps.es: Cambia los menús del clic derecho de Explorer; no afecta a ii.
apps.en: It changes Explorer's right-click menus; it does not affect ii.

apps.name: Start11
apps.es: Reemplaza el menú Inicio y la barra, como ii. Si al pulsar la tecla Windows sale el de Start11, desactiva en Start11 su barra y su uso de la tecla Windows.
apps.en: It replaces Start and the taskbar, like ii. If Start11's menu shows when you press the Windows key, turn off its taskbar and its use of the Windows key.

apps.name: Fences
apps.es: Ordena los iconos del escritorio de Windows; ii dibuja su propio escritorio encima, así que sus cercas no se ven mientras ii está activo.
apps.en: It arranges Windows' desktop icons; ii draws its own desktop on top, so its fences are not visible while ii runs.

apps.name: DisplayFusion
apps.es: Puede poner su propia barra de tareas en cada monitor: desactívala si ves dos barras con ii.
apps.en: It can add its own taskbar on each monitor: turn it off if you see two bars with ii.
